# Bobcorn API Context

- Bobcorn API docs: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/
- Bobcorn OpenAPI spec: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/openapi.json
- Auth docs: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/auth.html
- Auth JSON: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/auth.json
- Rate limits: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/rate-limits.html
- Rate limits JSON: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/rate-limits.json
- Error model: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/errors.html
- Error model JSON: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/errors.json
- Status: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/status.json
- Webhooks docs: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/webhooks.html
- MCP status: https://bobcorn.caldis.me/api/mcp.html

The public Bobcorn website API is static and read-only. It exposes release metadata, changelog metadata, Markdown content, and agent discovery files. It does not expose hosted project CRUD, OAuth, account management, or remote export jobs.
